# Madison Walker

Madison Walker is a Postbaccalaureate SPARK Fellow at the Harvard & Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics, advised by Dr. Rachel Bowens-Rubin. She studies directly imaged exoplanets and planetary-mass companions in circumbinary systems using JWST MIRI and ground-based high-contrast imaging.

- Home: https://madisonwalker321.github.io/madison_walker_web/
- CV: https://madisonwalker321.github.io/madison_walker_web/files/cv.pdf
- Research: https://madisonwalker321.github.io/madison_walker_web/#research
- Contact: https://madisonwalker321.github.io/madison_walker_web/#contact
